topic_title: Environmental Hazards — Low-Water, Fog, Ice & Wind
prompt: What is the official National Weather Service and TxDOT safety rule regarding flooded roadways?

options.text: Accelerate heavily to create a bow wave to keep water from entering engine intake
Drive down the center yellow stripe where water pavement depth is lowest
'Turn Around, Don't Drown'; never drive into water across a road or crossing
Follow closely behind large commercial pickup trucks through standing waters
